failure.scope: full exact original FAIL excerpt; no full workspace log parsing in this report

source_chain.finding: The transport event loop awaits process_request, then performs post-initialize bookkeeping serially. After the initialize response, it queues existing configuration warnings and remoteControl status, then awaits connection_initialized before taking another transport event. The observed remoteControl notification does not prove the last await or Bedrock dispatch completed.

JSON transport passes outbound_initialized=None; initialize sends the response then returns false. Its later initialize notifications iterate already stored config_warnings and queue notifications, without reloading configuration or refreshing models.
The initialized JSON notification is only logged. It has no additional awaited work or external operation.

The delegated operation awaits the state Mutex then inserts connection capabilities in live_connections. This body performs no external I/O. Lock availability and scheduling in the failed run are unobserved.
process_request registers request context, deserializes and invokes the shared handler; errors queue a response. The entry trace is before context registration and dispatch.
BedrockSetup uses global(account-auth), an Exclusive request serialization scope, not an unkeyed independent request.

Admission validates initialized/experimental capability, tracks the request synchronously, constructs the handler future and enqueues it. The event-stream special await is only for McpServerEventStreamStart, not BedrockSetup.

enqueue holds the map mutex only to insert/push and releases it before spawning the drain worker. The Exclusive worker awaits any earlier work on the same account-auth key in order. The map mutex is not held over the handler future.

The gate locks accepting only long enough to reject or acquire a TaskTracker token. It releases the lock before awaiting the handler and drops the token after completion. The token tracks lifetime, not an additional external task.
The request future is awaited once. Ok(Some(response)) directly awaits outgoing.send_response_as; there is no handler-external model refresh on this path.
The Bedrock dispatch arm directly awaits account_processor.bedrock_setup(params). AWS validation and config-write internals remain the peer investigation scope.
Response serialization invokes synchronous analytics tracking, removes the context through a short mutex operation, then queues an outgoing envelope.
The outgoing envelope send awaits channel capacity and uses write_complete_tx=None. It does not await a response acknowledgement from the client.

Routing awaits the stdio writer channel when that connection cannot be disconnected; disconnectable connections instead use try_send. Channel backpressure is a possible boundary, not a demonstrated cause.

existing_tracing.configured_stderr_layer: Both JSON and Default fmt layers request FmtSpan::FULL and EnvFilter::from_default_env(). LOG_FORMAT changes format; RUST_LOG controls the filter. The code calls try_init and ignores its result, so source alone does not establish which subscriber was active in the failed process.
existing_tracing.other_layers: feedback logger/metadata, optional state log DB and OTEL layers also attached; their internals are not re-audited here.

request_span.name: app_server.request
request_span.fields: method, request id, connection id, transport, client metadata; no Bedrock params or credentials

existing_tracing.what_existing_spans_can_distinguish: Request arrival and polling/lifetime of the request or serialization queue when those filters are enabled. Reused request span enter/exit is not a unique marker for a particular Bedrock await.
existing_tracing.what_they_do_not_distinguish: No distinct stage labels for profile validation, active-login cancellation, config-layer load, or config-write completion in the reviewed dispatch functions.

observed_vs_inferred.observed: Original test sends initialize 0, receives its response, sends initialized and first profile request 1, then sees remoteControl status before the unchanged 10-second reader deadline expires.
observed_vs_inferred.source_supported: Post-initialize connection registration, account-auth queue admission/order, RPC gate admission, and response channels are explicit await boundaries. No additional model refresh is awaited by these reviewed dispatch bodies.

Whether it waited on initialization, queue predecessors, a mutex, handler-internal work, or outbound channel.
Whether any prior/background account-auth operation occupied the queue; this review is not a whole-program background-enqueue inventory.
